context: Interactive crossfilter dashboard with four linked views: scatter plot (amount vs quantity), histogram (amount distribution), categorical bar chart, and area chart (orders over time) — a data visualization tool for exploring 100k order records
first_impression: Functional four-panel crossfilter layout with clean grid structure, but the rainbow categorical palette in the bar and scatter charts clashes with the monochrome steelblue used in the histogram and time series, making the dashboard feel visually split rather than unified.
what_works: The 2x2 grid layout is well-proportioned with comfortable gutters, and the record-count badge ('100,000 / 100,000') and coral Reset All button show some UI polish beyond bare-minimum defaults.
what_doesnt: The category bar chart uses a full schemeCategory10 rainbow palette — the most generic D3 default — while the histogram and area chart use plain steelblue, so the dashboard has no unified color story; panel titles are all-caps at identical weight with no typographic hierarchy separating them from axis labels.
